title: Choose a response to the old build runner
question: What evidence would make this maintenance choice less uncertain?
disagreement: Replacing reduces the old-image risk, while pinning may preserve a known workflow during the migration.

choices.name: Patch
risks: A patch may not cover the unsupported base image
evidence: The vendor advisory names the affected package

choices.name: Pin
risks: Known vulnerable image remains in use
evidence: Last successful build used this image
missing: No expiry date for the exception

choices.name: Replace
risks: Migration could break the release job
evidence: A replacement image builds the fixture project

choices.name: Defer
risks: Support window may close before review
